name: Painterly / illustrated
why: The prettiest and the most expensive to keep consistent. Brush texture and soft light give a validator almost nothing to measure, so quality control falls back on human review — which is the cost this pipeline exists to remove. Use it for tier-A key art, and think hard before using it for hundreds of gameplay assets.

prompt_skeleton.style_medium: digital painting, painterly brushwork, soft edges, rich value range
prompt_skeleton.lighting_mood: single key light from {light_direction}, ambient occlusion in the crevices, consistent colour temperature
constraints: asset fills the canvas with a {margin_pct}% margin
consistent brush scale across the asset set

unit_design_rules: Skeletal cut-up is the weak point: a brush stroke that crosses a joint cannot be split without a visible break. Design silhouettes so every joint sits under an overlapping element.
A locked reference sheet is not optional here — it is the only thing holding the set together.
